title: Virtual Card Management: Getting Started with Virtual Cards
summary: This document explains how to get started with Virtual Cards in the dashboard: instant issuance is available with an expected issuance time of 5 seconds, and each account can have up to 60 active virtual cards. Virtual card management has a $25.00 annual fee, and supports recurring-use cards for repeated transactions with the same vendor. It also covers first-issuance troubleshooting (refresh and confirm instant issuance; archive/cancel cards if near 60).
